sections.title: Title
sections.guidance: One line: what we propose, for whom. For example: Cloud migration and Workspace rollout for <prospect>.

sections.title: Executive summary
sections.guidance: Three or four sentences: their situation, what we propose, and why it fits. Use their facts and our offerings.

sections.title: Our understanding of your situation
sections.guidance: Four to six bullets drawn only from research facts (c:), inferences (i:) and what they told us (r:).

sections.title: Proposed scope
sections.guidance: One bullet per need we meet: the offering and the features that meet it. For partial fits, the customisation. For needs we can't meet, say so plainly and name the partner if there is one.

sections.title: Approach and indicative timeline
sections.guidance: Three to five phases in order. Give a duration only when an offering's typical length provides it.

sections.title: Indicative pricing
sections.guidance: One sentence introducing the table. Code renders the table itself. Never write an amount: use {{price:<lineId>}} if you refer to a line.

sections.title: Relevant work
sections.guidance: Only the results given to you, all public. If none were given, say case studies are available on request.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.guidance: Two to four concrete next steps. Use the meeting date if one is given.
